title: Trainee / Junior Python Developer (on-site)
description:
We're a fast-growing tech company building modern, innovative digital products - and we're looking for a Python Developer to join our team in Lviv. If you care about clean code, solid architecture, and working in an environment where your input actually matters, keep reading.
What you'll be doing
You'll be part of a cross-functional team working on real, meaningful projects - building scalable backend solutions, designing APIs, and helping shape the technical decisions that move our products forward.
What we're looking for
- Solid hands-on experience with Python
- Strong knowledge of Django and Django REST Framework
- Good understanding of OOP principles and clean code practices
- Experience working with relational databases - MySQL and/or PostgreSQL
- Confident use of Git and version control workflows
- Responsible, self-motivated, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
What we offer
- Full-time, in-office position in Lviv
- Official employment and a competitive salary based on your skills and experience
- Company-provided equipment
- A well-structured work schedule
- A friendly, supportive team and a comfortable office environment
- Mentorship and guidance from experienced colleagues
- Interesting and technically challenging projects to grow on
How to apply
Send us your CV - we review every application and get back to candidates promptly. This could be the start of something great.
